_comment: Errand definitions, kept separate from the content master spreadsheet per Zafar's instruction. This build proves ONE errand: the fruit bowl. Word ids match Scene — Bazaar in the content master. Every kutchi line used here traces to a sourced draft in content.json; nothing here invents Kutchi. Slot assignment (which gap/stall slot each word lands in) is shuffled at runtime from gap_slots/slot_pool, seeded from Date.now(), so the targets are never in the same place twice. Pear qty is 2 (was 3) so it matches the only sourced plural line, Muke bo naaspati khape (bo = two); never compose a new Kutchi line to fit a quantity.

intro_beat.gist: Eid is tomorrow and the guests are coming tonight!

outro_beat.gist: The fruit is ready. Now help me cook dinner.
